verses.en: Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who now is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods!
verses.head: Hymn 1 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled. milk. Divine, God-loving, for the God.
Bring health to cattle with thy flow, health to the people, health, to steeds, Health, O thou King, to growing plants!
Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly, And form that shouteth all around.
verses.head: Hymn 2 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Roused by his drivers and sent forth, the strong Steed hath come: nigh for spoil, As warriors when they stand arrayed.
Specially, Soma, Sage, by day, coming together for our weal, Like Surya, flow for us to see!
The streams of Pavamana, thine, Sage, mighty one, have poured them forth, Like coursers eager for renown.
verses.head: Hymn 3 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: They have been poured upon the Reece towards the meath-distilling vat: The holy songs have rung aloud.
Like milch-kine coming home, the drops of Soma juice have reached the lake, Have reached the shrine of sacrifice
Come, Agni, praised with song to feast and sacrificial offerings: sit As Hotar on the holy grass!
verses.head: Hymn 4 · Agni

verses.en: So, Angiras, we make thee strong with fuel and with holy oil. Blaze high, thou youngest of the Gods!
For us thou winnest, Agni, God, heroic strength exceeding great, Far-spreading and of high renown.
Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!
verses.head: Hymn 5 · Mitra Varuna

verses.en: Gladdened by homage, ruling far, ye reign by majesty of might, Pure in your ways, for evermore.
Lauded by Jamadagni's song, sit in the shrine of sacrifice: Drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law!
Come, we have pressed theJuice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass!
verses.head: Hymn 6 · Indra

verses.en: O Indra, let thy long-maned bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward! Give ear and listen to our prayers!
We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.
Indra and Agni, moved by songs, come to the juice, the precious dew: Drink ye thereof, impelled by prayer!
verses.head: Hymn 7 · Indra Agni

verses.en: Indra and Agni, with the man who lauds comes visible sacrifice: So drink ye both this flowing juice!
With force of sacrifice I seek Indra, Agni who love the wise: With Soma let them sate them here!
High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained Dread sheltering power and great renown.
verses.head: Hymn 8 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore, For Varuna and the Marut host!
Striving to win, with him we gain all riches from the enemy, Yea, all the glories of mankind,
Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in watery robe. Giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold.
verses.head: Hymn 9 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: He, milking for dear meath the heavenly udder, hath sat in the ancient gathering-place. Washed by the men, far-sighted, strong, thou streamest to ther honourable reservoir.
Run onward to the reservoir and seat thee: cleansed by the men speed forward to the battle. Making thee glossy like an able courser, forth to the sacred grass with reins they lead thee.
verses.head: Hymn 10 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Indu, the well-armed God is flowing onward, he who averts the curse and guards the homesteads. Father, begetter of the Gods, most skilful, the buttress of the heavens and earth's supporter.
Like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra! of what moveth not.
verses.head: Hymn 11 · Indra

verses.en: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra Maghavan! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.
With what help will he come to us, wonderful, everwaxing friend? With what most mighty company?
verses.head: Hymn 12 · Indra

verses.en: What genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e'en strongly-guarded wealth?
Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us!
As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice.
verses.head: Hymn 13 · Indra

verses.en: Celestial, bounteous giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in pleasant things,-- Him swift we seek for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.
Loud-singing at tbe sacred rite where Soma flows, we priests invoke. With haste, that he may help, as the bard's cherisher. Indra who findeth wealth for you.
verses.head: Hymn 14 · Indra

verses.en: Whom, fair of cheek, in rapture of the juice, the firm resistless slayers hinder not: Giver of glorious wealth to him who sings his praise, honouring him who toils and pours.
In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, Pressed out for Indra, for his drink!
verses.head: Hymn 15 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Fiend-queller, friend of all men, he hath reached his shrine, his dwelling-place. Within the iron-hammered vat.
Be thou best Vritra-slaver, best granter of room, most liberal: Promote our wealthy princes' gifts!
For Indra flow, thou Soma, on, as most inspiring drink, most rich in sweets, Great, most Celestial, gladdening drink!
verses.head: Hymn 16 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Thou of whom having drunk the Steer acts like a steer: having drunk this that finds the light, He, excellently wise, hath come anear to food and booty, even as Etasa.
To Indra, to the mighty let these golden-coloured juices go, Drops born as Law prescribes, that find the light of heaven!
verses.head: Hymn 17 · Indra

verses.en: This juice that gathers spoil flows, pressed, for Indra, for his maintenance. Soma bethinks him of the conqueror, as he knows.
Yea, Indra in the joys of this obtains the grasp that gathers spoil, And, winning waters, wields the mighty thunderbolt.
For first possession of your juice, for the exhilarating drink, Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away!
verses.head: Hymn 18 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: He who with purifying stream, effused, comes flowing hitherward, Indu, is like an able steed.
With prayer all-reaching let the men tend unassailable Soma: be- The stones prepared for sacrifice!
Graciously- minded he is flowing on his way to win dear names o'er which the youthful one grows great. The mighty and far-seeing one hath mounted now the mighty Surya's car which moves to every side.
verses.head: Hymn 19 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: The speaker, unassailable master of this prayer, the tongue of sacrifice, pours forth the pleasant meath. As son be sets the name of mother and of sire in the far distance, in the third bright realm of heaven.

Sending forth flashes he hath bellowed to the jars, led by the men into the golden reservoir. The milkers of the sacrifice have sung to him: Lord of three heights, thou shinest brightly o'er the Dawns.
Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength! Come, let us praise the wise and everlasting God, even as a well-beloved friend:
verses.head: Hymn 20 · Agni

verses.en: The Son of Strength; for is be not our gracious Lord? Let us serve him who bears our gifts! In battles may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives!
O Agni, come; far other songs of praise will I sing forth to thee. Wax mighty with these Soma drops!
verses.head: Hymn 21 · Agni

verses.en: Where'er thy mind applies itself, vigour preeminent hast thou: There wilt thou gain a dwelling-place.
Not for a moment only lasts thy bounty, Lord of many men: Our service therefore shalt thou gain.
We call on thee, O matchless one. We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves. Call on thee, wondrous, thunder-armed:
verses.head: Hymn 22 · Indra

verses.en: On thee for aid in sacrifice, This youth of ours, the bold, the terrible, bath gone forth. We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, spoil winner, as our succourer.
So, Indra, friend of song, do we draw near to thee with longing; we have streamed to thee Coming like floods that follow floods.
verses.head: Hymn 23 · Indra

verses.en: As rivers swell the ocean, so, hero, our prayers increase thy might, Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.
With holy song they bind to the broad wide-yoked car the bay steeds of the quickening God, Bearers of Indra, yoked by word.
Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live!
verses.head: Hymn 1 · Indra

verses.en: Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song renowned of old: His name is Indra, tell it forth!
Indra, the dancer, be to us the giver of abundant wealth: The mighty bring it us knee-deep!
Sing ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of tawny steeds, The Soma-drinker, O my friends!
verses.head: Hymn 2 · Indra

verses.en: To him, the bounteous, say the laud, and let us glorify, as men May do, the giver of true gifts!
O Indra, Lord of boundless might, for us thou seekest spoil and kine, Thou seekest gold for us, good Lord!
This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends, The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns.
verses.head: Hymn 3 · Indra

verses.en: Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy; On thy laud only have I thought.
The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep: They punish sloth unweariedly
For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice: Let poets sing the song of praise
verses.head: Hymn 4 · Indra

verses.en: We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom The seven communities rejoice.
At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind: Let our songs aid and prosper it!
Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof!
verses.head: Hymn 5 · Indra

verses.en: Strong-rayed! adored with earnest hymns! this juice is shed for thy delight: Thou art invoked, Akhandala!
To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Sringavrish! to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.
Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand, Manifold and nutritious spoil!
verses.head: Hymn 6 · Indra

verses.en: We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth. Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.
Hero when thou wouldst give thy gifts, neither the Gods nor mortal men Restrain thee like a fearful bull.
Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink: Sate thee and finish thy carouse!
verses.head: Hymn 7 · Indra

verses.en: Let not the fools, or those who mock, beguile thee when they seek thine aid: Love not the enemy of prayer!
Here let them cheer thee well supplied with milk to great munificence: Drink as the wild bull drinks the lake!
Here is the Soma juice expressed: O Vasu, drink till thou art full! Undaunted God, we give it thee!
verses.head: Hymn 8 · Indra

verses.en: Washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool, 'Tis like a courser bathed in streams.
This juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk. Indra, I call thee to our feast.
So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!
verses.head: Hymn 9 · Indra

verses.en: Incline thy body to the juice which suits thy godlike nature well: Thee, Soma-lover! let it cheer!
O Indra, let it enter both thy flanks, enter thy head with prayer, With bounty, hero! both thine arms!
O Come ye hither, sit ye down; to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise,
verses.head: Hymn 10 · Indra

verses.en: Laud Indra, richest of the rich, who ruleth over noblest wealth, Beside the flowing Soma juice!
May he stand near us in our need with all abundance, for our wealth: With strength may he come nigh to us!
In every need, in every fray we call, as friends to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
verses.head: Hymn 11 · Indra

verses.en: I call him, mighty to resist, the hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.
If he will hear us, let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, With strength and riches, to our call!
When Somas flow thou makest pure, Indra, thy mind that merits laud, For gain of strength that ever grows: for great is he.
verses.head: Hymn 12 · Indra

verses.en: In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success, Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the waterfloods.
Him I invoke, to win the spoil, even mighty Indra for the fray. Be thou most near to us for bliss, a friend to aid!
With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength. Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal, messenger of all.
verses.head: Hymn 13 · Agni

verses.en: His two red horses, all-supporting, let him yoke: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast! Then hath the sacrifice good prayers and happy end, the heavenly gift of wealth to men.
Advancing, sending forth her rays, the daughter of the Sky is seen. The mighty one lays bare the darkness with her eye, the friendly Lady makes the light.
verses.head: Hymn 14 · Dawn

verses.en: The Sun ascending, the refulgent star, pours down his beams. together with the Dawn. O Dawn, at thine arising, and, the Sun's, may we attain the share allotted us!
These morning sacrifices call you, Asvins, at the break of day. For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house, ye visit all.
verses.head: Hymn 15 · Asvins

verses.en: Ye, heroes, have bestowed wonderful nourishment: send it to him whose songs are sweet. One-minded, both of you, drive your car down to us: drink yethe savoury Soma juice!
After his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from The Sage who wins a thousand spoils.
verses.head: Hymn 16 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: In aspect he is like the Sun: he runneth forward to the lakes: Seven currents flowing to the sky.
He, while they purify him, stands high over all things that exist Soma, a God as Surya is.
By generation long ago this God, engendered for the Gods, Flows tawny to the straining cloth.
verses.head: Hymn 17 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: According to primeval plan this poet hath been strengthened by, The sage as God for all the Gods.
Shedding the ancient fiuid thou art poured into the cleansing sieve: Roaring, thou hast produced the Gods.
Bring near us those who stand aloof: strike fear into our enemy: O Pavamana, find us wealth!
verses.head: Hymn 18 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: To him the active, nobly born.
Sing ye your songs to him, O men!
The Somas skilled in song, the waves have led the water forward, like Buffaloes speeding to the woods.
verses.head: Hymn 19 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store Of kine into the wooden vats.
To Indra, Vayu. Varuna to Vishnu and the Maruts let The Soma juices flow expressed.
O Soma, for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge, Sweet with the liquor of the stalk, as one who wakes, into the vat that drops with meath.
verses.head: Hymn 20 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Like a dear son how must be decked, the bright and shining one hath clad him in his robe. Men skilful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their hands.
The rapture-shedding Somas have flowed forth in our assembly, pressed. To glorify our liberal lords.
verses.head: Hymn 21 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Now like a swan hemaketh all the company sing each his hymm He like steed is bathed in milk.
And Trita's maidens onward urge the tawny-coloured with the stones, Indu for Indra, for his drink.
Herewith flow on, thou friend of Gods! Singing, thou runnest round the sieve oni every side. The streams of meath have been effused.
verses.head: Hymn 22 · Soma Pavamana

verses.en: Lovely, gold-coloured, on he flows.
For him who presses, of the juice.
